heading: INT. VERTICAL FARM BREAK ROOM - FLUORESCENT PINK LIGHT - DAY

units.text: INT. VERTICAL FARM BREAK ROOM - FLUORESCENT PINK LIGHT - DAY
Under the grow-lamp glow, everyone looks sunburned and sick.
Racks of lettuce climb the walls behind the vending machine.
A sign on the fridge reads: THIS IS NOT A COMMUNAL FRIDGE.
IT IS A FRIDGE OF COMMUNITY.
PRIYANKA DESAI, thirties, Head of Culture, slides a cake onto the table with candles shaped like leaves.
NATHANIEL "NAT" OYELOWO, forties, a quiet agronomist, stands near the sink in a fleece vest.
WILHELMINA "BILLIE" STOCKTON, twenties, new hire, hovers by the door holding a tote bag.
Surprise! Welcome, Billie!
units.name: PRIYANKA

units.text: Oh my gosh. You didn't have to.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: We always do. Right, Nat?
units.name: PRIYANKA

units.text: We did for the last four.
units.name: NAT

units.text: Priyanka laughs a half-second too long.
Billie smiles and sets her bag on the counter.
Where do I... put my lunch?
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: She opens the fridge.
Inside, every shelf is labeled with a name.
One shelf has a pink sticky note: BILLIE'S, in Priyanka's handwriting.
Another, in Nat's: FORMER BILLIE'S.
Billie looks at the note.
She looks at Nat.
Nat looks at the lettuce.
Who was the former Billie?
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Nobody. A joke. Cake?
units.name: PRIYANKA

units.text: She hands Billie a plate.
She takes it with both hands, politely, and turns to Nat.
Did she quit, or...
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: She harvested.
units.name: NAT
